# Test Fixtures

Test archives used to verify cooViewer archive handling, image ordering,
filename decoding, image dimensions, scaling, and rendering.

## Source images

The canonical source images are stored in `src/`.

All images are released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

## Generate archives

```sh
tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.sh
```

Generated archives are written to `generated/` and are not committed to Git.

The script generates fixtures for:

- ZIP
- CBZ
- TAR
- 7z, when `7zz` is installed
- CBR, when `rar` is installed
- ZIP with UTF-8 Japanese filenames
- ZIP with CP932 Japanese filenames

## Filename encoding fixtures

`test_utf8.zip` stores Japanese filenames as UTF-8 and sets the ZIP UTF-8
language encoding flag.

`test_sjis.zip` stores Japanese filenames as CP932 byte sequences without
the ZIP UTF-8 language encoding flag. This represents legacy ZIP archives
commonly created by Japanese Windows applications.

The exact filename encoding is part of the fixture and is generated by
`make_sjis_fixture.py`.

## Expected page order

1. `001.png`
2. `002.jpg`
3. `003.png`
4. `004.jpg`

Japanese filename fixtures use the following names:

1. `001_表紙.png`
2. `002_縦長表示.jpg`
3. `003_網点とカケアミ.png`
4. `004_拡大縮小.jpg`

## Baseline results — 2026-07-11

Manual check of every archive in `generated/` against the current
Deployment build (v1.3.6 + resource consolidation, commit `ded598e`),
opened in the app; page names/order read from the page-bar HUD.

| Archive | Opens | Filenames correct | Page order correct |
|---|---|---|---|
| test.zip | ✓ | ✓ (001.png–004.jpg) | ✓ (1→2/3 spread→4) |
| test.cbz | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| test.tar | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| test.7z | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| test.cbr | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| test_utf8.zip | ✓ | ✓ UTF-8 Japanese decoded | ✓ |
| test_utf8.7z | ✓ | ✓ UTF-8 Japanese decoded | ✓ (pages 1–3 verified) |
| test_utf8.cbr | ✓ | ✓ UTF-8 Japanese decoded | ✓ |
| test_sjis.zip | ✓ | ✓ CP932 detected & decoded | ✓ |

CP932/UTF-8 filename decoding is performed inside XADMaster via
UniversalDetector — relevant baseline for any future submodule swap
(see `docs/audit-20260711.md` §2b).
